contract.title: Scope a first reproduction checkpoint for WACA
contract.rawGoal: I want to reproduce WACA, but I do not know where to begin.
contract.objective: Produce a one-page scope note and next-action checklist that define a bounded first checkpoint for reproducing WACA, including the source description to rely on, required inputs, expected outputs, and explicit exclusions.

deliverables.description: A file named waca-reproduction-scope.md containing a one-page scope note with sections for source description, first checkpoint, inputs, outputs, and out-of-scope items.
A file named waca-next-actions.md containing a checklist of at most five concrete next actions for the first reproduction checkpoint.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The file waca-reproduction-scope.md exists and contains separate sections for source description, first checkpoint, inputs, outputs, and out-of-scope items.

evidenceRequirements.description: Inspect waca-reproduction-scope.md for the five named sections.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The first checkpoint is a single bounded action with an observable success condition, not a full reproduction.

evidenceRequirements.description: Inspect the first checkpoint section of waca-reproduction-scope.md for one action and one observable success condition.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The scope note lists at least one required input and one expected output for the first checkpoint, using placeholders where specifics are unknown and not inventing names beyond WACA.

evidenceRequirements.description: Inspect the inputs and outputs sections of waca-reproduction-scope.md for at least one input and one output.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The out-of-scope section names full reproduction, benchmark or performance matching, and unresolved WACA subgoals.

evidenceRequirements.description: Inspect the out-of-scope section of waca-reproduction-scope.md for the three excluded categories.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A next-action checklist exists with at most five items.

evidenceRequirements.description: Inspect waca-next-actions.md and count the checklist items.

inScope: Defining what reproducing WACA means for a first bounded attempt
Identifying or recording the source description to rely on
Writing the first observable checkpoint, inputs, outputs, and exclusions
Producing a next-action checklist for the first checkpoint
outOfScope: Resolving all unknowns about WACA before starting

known: The user wants to reproduce WACA.
The user states they do not know where to begin.
No prior WACA materials, artifacts, or evidence were provided.
unknowns: Which source description or release the user intends to reproduce.
Required runtime, dependencies, data, and compute.
What counts as a successful reproduction.
Whether the user has access to any WACA materials.
assumptions: WACA is a named system or method with at least one authoritative description.
A one-page scope note is sufficient for this first step.
The user can spend about 60 minutes on this step.
The first checkpoint can be defined before resolving every unknown.
